description: Land Title Settlement Department - Meddegoda. Ja-Ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512210 (23/0720)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and property ownership matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, owners, property extents, encumbrances, and legal interests related to real estate, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
